caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of an upholstered sofa with a wooden frame. The sofa has a curved, ornate backrest and armrests, with intricate wood carvings that are particularly prominent along the top center and base of the seat. The upholstery is depicted in a pink or peach color with a decorative floral pattern in shades of green, yellow, and red. Above the sofa, there is a pencil sketch of an ornamental floral design, presumably intended for the wooden portion of the sofa's frame. To the upper left, there is a detailed colored rendering of the floral fabric pattern, showing pink and red flowers with green leaves on a red background. Below the sofa, there is a smaller pencil sketch of another ornamental wood carving. Several scale indicators are present throughout the drawing, providing reference for the dimensions of the different decorative elements and the overall furniture piece. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Sofa
